body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.65 (naive sector base rate 0.62) that: Persistent Q4FY27 revenue excluding Nagarro is >=USD 500 mn (the re-cast 'USD 2 bn by FY27' run rate). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/IT_MIDCAPS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.62 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=11); SAC +13.9 pts x weight 0.167 (N=4) -> p = 0.65. Evidence: Q4FY26 (21-Apr-2026): 'FY'27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so' ('plus minus a quarter at worst'); re-cast from Jul-2025 'reach $2 billion by FY27'. Q2FY27 USD 487.6 mn organic (+7.8% QoQ incl. a large-deal ramp). Resolution: YES if Persistent's Q4 FY27 USD revenue excluding Nagarro is >= USD 500.0 mn. If Nagarro is not consolidated in Q4 FY27, reported USD revenue is used. If it is consolidated and Persistent does not disclose an ex-Nagarro (organic/standalone Persistent) USD figure by 2027-06-30, the call is VOID. Source: Persistent Q4 FY27 press release / factsheet / call (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.62 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=11); SAC +13.9 pts x weight 0.167 (N=4) -> p = 0.65
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'revenue_growth' promises among the other IT mid-cap peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=11). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if Persistent's Q4 FY27 USD revenue excluding Nagarro is >= USD 500.0 mn. If Nagarro is not consolidated in Q4 FY27, reported USD revenue is used. If it is consolidated and Persistent does not disclose an ex-Nagarro (organic/standalone Persistent) USD figure by 2027-06-30, the call is VOID.
data.resolution_source: Persistent Q4 FY27 press release / factsheet / call (NSE)
